     2	
     3	We presented a closed-loop framework connecting spectral collapse monitoring to budget-constrained adaptive real-data allocation during recursive synthetic training.
     4	Our contributions are threefold:
     5	
     6	\paragraph{Spectral characterization and closed-loop framework.}
     7	We provide, to our knowledge, the first spectral-level characterization of how effective rank evolves across recursive synthetic training generations, and propose a closed-loop framework that translates spectral health signals into adaptive data mixing decisions. \textbf{[TBD: spectral trajectory characterization]}
     8	
     9	\paragraph{Empirical validation.}
    10	Spectral-guided adaptive allocation improves perplexity and downstream accuracy over uniform and scheduled baselines under a fixed real-data budget.
    11	\textbf{[TBD: key metrics]}
    12	
    13	\paragraph{Signal-flexible controller.}
    14	We introduce a budget-constrained proportional controller validated with spectral health signals (effective rank, spectral log-volume).
    15	By construction, total real-data consumption is identical to uniform allocation; only the temporal schedule differs.
    16	The framework is extensible to other monotonically-declining metrics such as calibration error.
    17	
    18	\subsection{Limitations}
    19	% To be refined after experiments
    20	\begin{itemize}[nosep]
    21	  \item Validated on a single model family (Pythia-410M~\cite{biderman2023pythia}); generalization to other architectures remains unverified.
    22	  \item Fixed data scale (50K samples per generation from The Pile~\cite{gao2020pile}).
    23	  \item Controller hyperparameters ($\tau$, $k$) require offline calibration from a Phase~0 pilot run.
    24	  \item Evaluated on a single text domain; multi-domain robustness is untested.
    25	  \item Phase~0 go/no-go judgment is based on a single seed (\texttt{seed=42}); Phase~1 introduces 3-seed statistical testing.
    26	  \item Any 1B scale-transfer results are from a single-seed pilot only.

    35	  \item Extension to multi-modal settings where representation collapse may manifest differently.
